evaluations.outcome: suggestion: analyzed 6 comparable successful scheduled docs.yml parent runs from 2026-09-10T05:32:21Z to 2026-09-10T08:31:14Z plus their dispatched dashboard-build child runs. Parent workflow median execution was 88.5s (p90 106.5s) with dashboard/build/deploy job medians of 38s/31s/9s and zero queue time. Trusted child-run metadata confirmed cached activity reuse on all 6 samples because 'Dispatch activity refresh' was skipped every time, yet docs.yml still dispatches dashboard-build and waits for it on every schedule run. The parent dashboard job spends a 33s median (p90 36s) almost entirely in 'Dispatch dashboard build', while the child build job adds a 14s median (p90 20s). Current parent 'Restore dashboard from cache' then uses the child run-specific key and usually downloads the artifact instead of serving from a preexisting cache. With fresh activity already restored from cache in the child, this repeated workflow dispatch plus child rebuild path is avoidable for cache-mode schedule runs. Recommend first checking for the latest reusable dashboard artifact/cache in docs.yml and only dispatching dashboard-build when no fresh cached dashboard bundle is available or when mode=live. Expected savings are roughly 33s median at the parent step level and about 47s combined median across parent wait plus child build, exceeding the 15% median threshold but below 60s. Parent workflow queue time median was 4s (p90 35.9s) and execution median was 89s (p90 100.3s). Parent job medians were dashboard 39s, build 30.5s, and deploy 9s. Trusted step metadata confirmed the parent build job hit the node_modules cache on all 10 samples because Install dependencies and Save node_modules were skipped every time. Trusted child-run metadata also confirmed cache-mode dashboard builds reused cached activity snapshots on all 10 samples because Dispatch activity refresh completed in 0s every time after the cache lookup step. Despite those cache hits, docs.yml still dispatched dashboard-build on every scheduled run, spending a 33.5s median (p90 38s) in the parent Dispatch dashboard build step while child dashboard-build added a 23s median execution time (p90 30.1s). In the child build job, Restore collected activity data median was 1s, Build Dashboard Language sources median 1s, and Upload dashboard artifact median 3s, showing the remaining repeated work is mostly workflow dispatch and artifact handoff rather than data generation. Because schedule runs default to cache mode, adding a same-revision reusable dashboard shortcut in docs.yml that restores a persisted dashboard bundle before dispatching dashboard-build and only dispatches when the bundle is missing or mode=live should avoid roughly 56.5s of combined median parent wait plus child execution, about 63% of the 89s median workflow execution time, without reducing freshness for live runs.
